badges.title: First Prompt
badges.directive: Entry achievement. Periwinkle and cobalt blue rim, navy inner field. Central icon: one friendly warm ivory rounded speech bubble with a short tail; inside it, a bold dark navy terminal prompt chevron and short underscore (>_) drawn as a simple pictogram, no other text. A tiny golden four-point spark touches the upper-right of the bubble and stays inside the frame. No rank star at the bottom. Bright, welcoming, very simple.

badges.title: Spark
badges.directive: Entry achievement. Same periwinkle and cobalt blue rim, navy inner field. Central icon: one large warm golden four-point spark with a bold lightning-shaped ivory inner facet; one small secondary gold sparkle at its upper right, fully inside the frame. It should read as a spark of creative energy, not a compass, flame or star rating. No rank star at bottom.

badges.title: Loop
badges.directive: Entry achievement. Same periwinkle and cobalt blue rim, navy inner field. Central icon: two chunky mint and ivory curved arrows forming a clear circular cycle, generously open center, arrow heads large and readable. No infinity symbol or text. No rank star at bottom.

badges.title: Builder
badges.directive: Intermediate achievement and style anchor. Violet/periwinkle beveled hex rim, dark navy inner field. Central icon: three chunky toy-like isometric building cubes forming a stable small pyramid: two base cubes and one upper cube, warm golden yellow top cube, ivory lower-left cube, pale periwinkle lower-right cube. Broad solid face colors with confident navy outlines, no tiny seams. Exactly one small gold five-point rank star centered in the bottom inside the hex beneath the cubes. Playful accomplishment, polished but very clean.

badges.title: Flow
badges.directive: Intermediate achievement. Match Builder's violet/periwinkle rim and navy inner field. Central icon: three bold interleaving flowing wave bands, ivory, sky blue and mint, sweeping together upward from left to right in one compact fluid shape. Use clean solid-color planes and big negative spaces, no gradient or water texture. Exactly one small gold five-point rank star at bottom, same size and position as Builder.

badges.title: Navigator
badges.directive: Intermediate achievement. Match Builder's violet/periwinkle rim and navy inner field. Central icon: a friendly stylized compass, thick warm ivory circular casing enclosing a clear two-ended diagonal gold-and-periwinkle compass needle on deep blue. No letters, tick marks, numerals or map background. Exactly one small gold five-point rank star at bottom, same as Builder.

badges.title: Century
badges.directive: Advanced achievement. Warm golden yellow and amber solid-facet beveled hex rim, navy inner field. Central icon: a large celebratory gold trophy cup with two broad handles, ivory glint plane, sturdy pale ivory pedestal and a simple small navy diamond inset; no numeral or text. Exactly two small gold five-point rank stars centered at bottom with generous spacing.

badges.title: Architect
badges.directive: Advanced achievement. Match Century's warm golden yellow/amber beveled hex rim and navy field. Central icon: one refined compact architectural tower assembled from broad ivory and pale blue geometric blocks, stepped shoulders, two bold navy window openings and a golden roof/keystone. More deliberate and taller than the Builder cubes; no cityscape or blueprint grid. Exactly two small gold five-point rank stars at bottom, same as Century.

badges.title: Keystone
badges.directive: Advanced achievement marking one year. Match Century's golden yellow/amber beveled hex rim and navy field. Central icon: a sturdy ivory stone arch with broad pale periwinkle side blocks, a dominant golden trapezoid keystone locking its apex, and a generous dark navy arch opening. A simple emblem of durable structure; not a crown, not a logo. Exactly two small gold five-point rank stars at bottom, same as Century.

badges.title: Continuum
badges.directive: Ultimate achievement marking two years. Same base hex shape but platinum silver and icy periwinkle outer rim with one thin gold inner rim, navy inner field. Central icon: a bold continuous horizontal infinity ribbon woven from warm gold and ivory planes, clear large negative-space loops, a small pale blue four-point star above it inside the hex. Exactly three small gold five-point rank stars at bottom. Highest prestige through balanced silhouette, not micro-detail; no crown outside the frame or outer decorations.
